lyd_c3_round_current_trigger = {
    lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes
    has_variable = lyd_c3_active
    faith = var:lyd_c3_round_faith
    rite = var:lyd_c3_round_main
    faith.main_rite = var:lyd_c3_round_main
    faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = temporal_head_of_faith }
    lyd_c3_claim_current_trigger = yes
    # Native temporary trigger scopes; no prev.prev global-link chains.
    $ACTOR$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = lyd_c3_checked_actor }
    scope:lyd_c3_checked_actor.var:lyd_c3_round_faith = { save_temporary_scope_as = lyd_c3_checked_faith }
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = lyd_c3_round_head }
        exists = faith.religious_head
        faith.religious_head = var:lyd_c3_round_head
        var:lyd_c3_round_head = { is_alive = yes faith = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_round_faith }
    }
    trigger_else = { NOT = { exists = faith.religious_head } }
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = lyd_c3_round_title }
        exists = faith.religious_head_title
        faith.religious_head_title = var:lyd_c3_round_title
    }
    trigger_else = { NOT = { exists = faith.religious_head_title } }
    NOT = { any_in_list = {
        variable = lyd_c3_rites
        save_temporary_scope_as = lyd_c3_checked_rite
        NOT = {
            faith = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_round_faith
            var:lyd_c3_proposal_owner = $ACTOR$
            var:lyd_c3_lock_serial = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_serial
            NOT = { has_variable = lyd_c2_proposal_owner }
            NOT = { has_variable = lyd_i3b_owner }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    var:lyd_c3_delegate_required = 1
                    exists = head_of_rite
                    head_of_rite = var:lyd_c3_delegate
                    var:lyd_c3_delegate = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes rite = scope:lyd_c3_checked_rite NOT = { has_trait = incapable } }
                }
                AND = {
                    var:lyd_c3_delegate_required = 0
                    rite_counties = 0
                    scope:lyd_c3_checked_faith = { NOT = { any_faith_character = { is_alive = yes rite = scope:lyd_c3_checked_rite } } }
                }
            }
        }
    } }
    # A newly added/removed rite or new player invalidates the old consent roster.
    var:lyd_c3_round_faith = {
        NOT = { any_faith_rite = { NOT = { var:lyd_c3_proposal_owner = $ACTOR$ var:lyd_c3_lock_serial = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_serial } } }
        NOT = { any_faith_character = {
            is_ai = no is_alive = yes
            NOT = { var:lyd_c3_affected_owner = $ACTOR$ var:lyd_c3_affected_serial = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_serial }
        } }
    }
    NOT = { any_in_list = {
        variable = lyd_c3_players
        NOT = {
            is_ai = no is_alive = yes
            faith = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_round_faith
            rite = var:lyd_c3_affected_rite
            var:lyd_c3_affected_owner = $ACTOR$
            var:lyd_c3_affected_serial = $ACTOR$.var:lyd_c3_serial
        }
    } }
}
